title: 잘 지내,
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop ballad featuring a soft female vocal lead. The arrangement is centered around a clean, arpeggiated electric guitar with a warm, jazz-influenced tone. A subtle electric bass provides melodic counterpoint with occasional slides. The tempo is 72 BPM in 4/4 time. The vocal delivery is intimate and breathy, utilizing a conversational register that shifts into a light head voice for higher melodic leaps. The production is minimalist, focusing on the clarity of the vocal and the resonance of the guitar strings without percussion.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[clean arpeggiated electric guitar]

[Verse 1]
[soft female vocals]
전화가 울려요 엄마
여보세요 밥 먹었어
니 먹었어 요 안 먹었어 요 [bass enters with melodic slides]
회사는 괜찮니 괜찮아요
어제 화장실에서 울었어요
건강해 니 건강해요
어깨가 아프고 목이 아파요

[Chorus]
괜찮아요 엄마
괜찮다는 말을 세 번 했어요
세 번 다 거짓말이에요
진짜를 말하면 엄마가 잠을 못 자요
